notes: Villanueva's campaign site could not be located; his evidence is his past record as sheriff (2018-2022) from Wikipedia and Daily Bruin plus limited campaign quotes. Luna's 2026 positions beyond his campaign priorities were not found.

robert-g-luna.text: Campaign priorities: reduce violent crime, increase public trust through relationship-based policing in communities of color, modernize the department, address homelessness, and improve deputy and employee wellness.

source.title: Robert Luna for Los Angeles County Sheriff (campaign site)

robert-g-luna.text: Says violent crime has fallen every year in the areas patrolled by LASD since he took office.

source.title: Robert Luna for Los Angeles County Sheriff (campaign site)

robert-g-luna.text: After the primary: "We need change. We need progress. The only way to do that is for us to work collectively."
As Long Beach police chief (2020), his department banned sleeper holds after George Floyd protests, calling it the "first of many steps" in community trust-building.
Endorsed by the LA County Federation of Labor, ALADS (deputy sheriffs), LAPPL, SEIU locals, Teamsters and UNITE HERE Local 11.
Endorsed by all five LA County Supervisors, the LA County District Attorney, Sen. Alex Padilla and the LA County Police Chiefs Association.

alex-villanueva.text: As sheriff in 2018, ordered a moratorium on transferring undocumented immigrants in jail to ICE and removed ICE agents from county jails; ended a federal data program that paid LA County about $122 million, calling it "blood money."
In 2020 secured $35 million in county funding for a department-wide body-worn camera program.
Hired about 1,100 deputies in his first year to address a staffing shortage of more than 1,300; transferred 36 deputies over alleged gang activity, suspending 22 and firing 4.
Declined to enforce COVID-19 vaccine requirements for department staff.
After the primary: "We look forward to a runoff and much-needed public debate over public safety. The LASD will not survive four more years of mismanagement."
Primary night: "People are tired of waiting for someone to take their safety seriously. I heard you, and I'm not going to let you down."

source.title: Luna and Villanueva set to face off in November (NBC LA)
